title: AI Assistant — JetBrains Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: AI Chat · Code Completion · In-Editor Actions · Agents · MCP · BYOK

rows.label: Install plugin
rows.value: Settings | Plugins | Marketplace → search AI Assistant → Install (not bundled by default)

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: CLion, DataGrip, GoLand, IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, PyCharm, Rider, RubyMine, RustRover, WebStorm, Android Studio

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: 2023.3 or later; Community Editions require 2024.1.1+

rows.label: Activation options
rows.value: JetBrains AI subscription · BYOK (API key) · Provider OAuth account · ACP external agent

rows.label: Free trial
rows.value: 30-day AI Pro trial; links to JetBrains Account; requires payment method on file

rows.label: License tiers
rows.value: AI Free (3 credits/30d) · AI Pro ($10, 10 credits) · AI Ultimate ($30, 35 credits)

rows.label: AI widget
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget in toolbar → tracks quota, credits, plan & quick settings

rows.label: Disable for project
rows.value: Widget → Disable AI Assistant → Disable for This Project; or drop .noai in project root

rows.label: Agent Client Protocol
rows.value: ACP support: install external agents from curated registry or via ~/.jetbrains/acp.json — no JetBrains AI subscription required

rows.label: Junie Debug mode
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate: Junie acts as AI debugger — sets breakpoints, inspects variables, evaluates expressions at runtime

rows.label: Skills system
rows.value: Reusable agent skills for Claude Agent & Codex; install from registry or custom dirs; invoke with $skill-name

rows.label: GitHub Copilot agent
rows.value: GitHub Copilot integrated as a coding agent in AI Chat (OAuth via GitHub account)

rows.label: Query plan AI
rows.value: DataGrip/DB plugin 2026.1+: Analyze SQL Plan with AI and Optimize Query with AI actions

rows.label: Junie remote session
rows.value: /remote command in Junie chat starts a browser-accessible remote session linked to the IDE

rows.label: Perforce MCP
rows.value: Detect Perforce project → configure Perforce MCP server → AI gains access to changelists, shelves & workspace data

rows.label: Next edit suggestions
rows.value: Predict the next code change; chain suggestions; support for rename refactorings & formatting-only edits (not on AI Free)

rows.label: Open AI Chat
rows.value: Click AI Chat button on right toolbar, or assign a custom shortcut under Keymap → Tool Windows → AI Assistant

rows.label: Switch mode/agent
rows.value: Click the mode selector button → choose Chat or any agent (Junie, Claude Agent, Codex, Copilot, ACP)

rows.label: New chat
rows.value: ⌘N or click New Chat button — starts a fresh context window; use per topic to limit token bleed

rows.label: Toggle Chat ↔ agent
rows.value: ⌘/ — toggles between Chat mode and the last selected agent

rows.label: Search in chat
rows.value: ⌘F inside a chat instance; same shortcut in Chat History list finds past chats

rows.label: Auto model
rows.value: Set model to Auto — AI Assistant picks best performance/cost balance automatically

rows.label: Custom response language
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant → Natural Language → enable and specify language

rows.label: Maximize chat window
rows.value: ⌘⇧' — maximize / restore the AI Assistant tool window

rows.label: @thisFile / @selection
rows.value: Reference current open file or editor selection without clicking Add attachment

rows.label: @file: / @folder:
rows.value: @file:Foo.kt or @folder:src — whole file or directory tree added as context

rows.label: @commit:
rows.value: Add a commit diff by hash — e.g. @commit:a1b2c3d

rows.label: @symbol:
rows.value: Add a specific symbol declaration — e.g. @symbol:UserService

rows.label: @problems / @localChanges
rows.value: @problems: issues in open file; @localChanges: uncommitted VCS diff

rows.label: @dbObject:
rows.value: Attach a database schema or table object (DataGrip / DB plugin 2025.2+)

rows.label: Add context from UI
rows.value: Add attachment → Add context from UI → pick terminal, console, Build output, etc.

rows.label: Disable codebase mode
rows.value: Click options icon → disable Enable Codebase Mode to attach all context manually; respects .gitignore & .aiignore when enabled

rows.label: /explain
rows.value: Explain a mentioned entity or attached code

rows.label: /refactor
rows.value: Suggest refactoring for code selected in the editor

rows.label: /web
rows.value: Search the internet; AI returns answer + source links

rows.label: /docs
rows.value: Search IDE documentation; may link to setting or docs page

rows.label: /help
rows.value: List available AI Chat features and commands

rows.label: Apply snippet
rows.value: Click Apply on a code snippet to merge it into the open file; review with Next/Prev Change buttons

rows.label: Run snippet
rows.value: Click Run Snippet to execute a generated terminal command or code directly

rows.label: Regenerate
rows.value: Click Regenerate this response at the bottom of a reply to get a fresh answer

rows.label: Trigger manually
rows.value: ⌥⇧\ — force a cloud completion suggestion at caret

rows.label: Accept full suggestion
rows.value: Tab (configurable) — accepts the entire inline suggestion

rows.label: Accept word-by-word
rows.value: ⌥→ — accept the next word of the suggestion

rows.label: Accept line-by-line
rows.value: ⌘→ — accept the next line of the suggestion

rows.label: Reject suggestion
rows.value: Esc — dismiss; also dismissed by typing or moving the caret

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Cloud completion uses Mellum (JetBrains FIM model) by default; override in Providers & API keys

rows.label: Completion policy
rows.value: Editor | Code Completion | Inline → Focused (strict) / Balanced / Creative (experimental)

rows.label: Enable in comments & commits
rows.value: Settings → Display Suggestions For → enable Commit Messages and AI Chat Input

rows.label: Open AI Actions menu
rows.value: ⌥↩ on selection → AI Actions; or right-click → AI Actions

rows.label: Generate code in editor
rows.value: ⌘\ on empty line → type prompt → Enter; generates code inline with diff view

rows.label: Edit selected code
rows.value: ⌘\ with selection → describe change → AI rewrites selection in-place

rows.label: Explain Code
rows.value: AI Actions → Explain Code — opens Chat with explanation; also works for RegExp, SQL, injected langs

rows.label: Generate Unit Tests
rows.value: AI Actions → Generate Unit Tests — opens AI Diff tab; click Accept all to save test file

rows.label: Write Documentation
rows.value: AI Actions → Write Documentation; or type /** / """ / // then Generate with AI Assistant

rows.label: Find Problems
rows.value: Select code → floating toolbar → Find Problems — Chat opens with bug/issue analysis

rows.label: Suggest Refactoring
rows.value: Select code → floating toolbar → Suggest Refactoring — Chat proposes and applies refactor via diff

rows.label: Junie (JetBrains)
rows.value: Autonomous multi-file agent; requires JetBrains AI subscription; respects .aiignore; instructions in AGENTS.md

rows.label: Junie Brave mode
rows.value: Toggle Brave Mode in chat input — executes commands without per-action confirmation

rows.label: Claude Agent modes
rows.value: Auto · Default · Accept Edits · Plan · Don't Ask · Bypass; instructions from CLAUDE.md

rows.label: Codex modes
rows.value: Read-only · Agent · Agent (full access); use AGENTS.md for instructions; BYOK requires direct OpenAI key

rows.label: GitHub Copilot modes
rows.value: Agent · Plan · Autopilot; OAuth via GitHub only; reads AGENTS.md & CLAUDE.md

rows.label: Rollback agent changes
rows.value: Hover changed file in agent pane → rollback icon (single file); or click Rollback for all files

rows.label: Agent /commands
rows.value: Type / in chat to list agent-specific slash commands (e.g. Junie: /usage, /remote, /ide)

rows.label: Approve operations
rows.value: Agents prompt for permission before bash commands or file edits; Allow / Always Allow / Reject

rows.label: AGENTS.md
rows.value: Place in repo root — Junie, Codex & Copilot read this for coding conventions, architecture rules, common commands

rows.label: CLAUDE.md
rows.value: Claude Agent (and Copilot) instruction file; same format as AGENTS.md; version-controlled alongside code

rows.label: Instruction file sections
rows.value: Include: project context, dev rules, build/test commands, restrictions, definition of done

rows.label: Project rules vs. instructions
rows.value: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md = agent-scoped; Project Rules (.aiassistant/rules/*.md) = Chat mode only

rows.label: Install skills
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Skills → browse registry → Install at IDE, Project, or Agent level

rows.label: Invoke skill explicitly
rows.value: Type $skill-name in the agent chat input; agent also invokes relevant skills automatically

rows.label: Import existing skills
rows.value: IDE detects skills from ~/.codex/skills or ~/.claude/skills and offers to import them

rows.label: ACP custom agent config
rows.value: Edit ~/.jetbrains/acp.json — set agent_servers with command, args, env keys

rows.label: Add MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | MCP → Add → paste JSON config (STDIO or HTTP transport)

rows.label: STDIO config format
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"command":"...","args":[...]}}}

rows.label: HTTP config format
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"url":"https://...","type":"streamable-http"}}}

rows.label: Import from Claude Desktop
rows.value: MCP settings → Import from Claude — reuses existing Claude Desktop MCP configuration

rows.label: IDE as MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | MCP Server → Enable → Auto-Configure clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code…)

rows.label: Expose to agents
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Agents → enable Pass custom MCP servers and/or Pass IntelliJ MCP server

rows.label: Invoke MCP tool manually
rows.value: Type / in chat — MCP tools appear alongside built-in commands; agents also auto-invoke when relevant

rows.label: MCP server logs
rows.value: Help → Show Log in Finder/Explorer → navigate to mcp/ folder for per-server logs

rows.label: BYOK settings path
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys → select Provider → enter API key → Test Connection

rows.label: Supported providers
rows.value: Anthropic · Gemini · Google Vertex AI (API key or ADC) · OpenAI · OpenAI-compatible · Ollama · LM Studio

rows.label: Local models
rows.value: Ollama or LM Studio: set Base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434), pick Model, configure context window (default 64k tokens)

rows.label: Assign models to features
rows.value: Model Assignment section → Core features / Instant helpers / Completion model (OpenAI-compatible & local only)

rows.label: BYOK + JetBrains AI
rows.value: Enable both: BYOK handles features with compatible models; JetBrains AI fills the rest (including next edit suggestions & Mellum completion)

rows.label: Reasoning models
rows.value: Brain icon in model picker = reasoning model (o3, Claude Opus series, etc.) — better for complex multi-step logic

rows.label: High-cost model warning
rows.value: Ruby icon in model picker = higher token cost; monitor quota counter in AI widget

rows.label: Revoke agent auth
rows.value: Providers & API keys → Agent Authorization → Revoke; create a new chat for changes to take effect

rows.label: Generate commit message
rows.value: Commit tool window ⌘0 → click Generate Commit Message with AI Assistant (sparkle icon)

rows.label: Customize commit prompt
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library → Commit Message Generation; use $GIT_BRANCH_NAME variable

rows.label: Self-Review with AI
rows.value: Commit window → select files → Self-Review with AI → Problems tool window shows AI-detected issues

rows.label: Explain commit
rows.value: VCS log ⌘9 → right-click commit → Explain Commit with AI Assistant

rows.label: Merge with AI
rows.value: Merge Revisions dialog → Merge with AI — resolves conflicting and non-conflicting changes

rows.label: PR title & description
rows.value: PR/MR creation tool window → click sparkle icon in description field → AI generates title & description

rows.label: Incoming PR summary
rows.value: Enable in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant → GitHub Plugin: Generate a summary upon opening a Pull Request

rows.label: Group with AI (experimental)
rows.value: Commit window → Group with AI button — clusters diff into High/Medium/Low impact changelists (requires Experimental Features plugin)

rows.label: Prompt Library
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library — add custom prompts or override built-in action prompts (tests, docs, commit)

rows.label: Save chat prompt
rows.value: Hover prompt in chat → click options → Save Current Prompt → appears in AI Actions menu

rows.label: $SELECTION variable
rows.value: Use in custom prompt body to insert the current editor selection as a formatted code block

rows.label: Chat Instructions prompt
rows.value: Prompt Library → General → Chat Instructions — auto-prepended to every new chat session

rows.label: Create project rule
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Rules → New Project Rules File → choose rule type (Always / Manual / By model decision / By file patterns)

rows.label: Invoke rule manually
rows.value: In chat type @rule:RuleName or use Add Attachment → select rule file (for rules set to Manually)

rows.label: Effective prompting
rows.value: One task per prompt · attach precise context · define done criteria · name constraints · ask agent to run tests after changes

rows.label: Start new chat per topic
rows.value: Reusing one long chat inflates context exponentially and degrades response quality — start fresh per topic

rows.label: .aiignore file
rows.value: Settings | AI Assistant | Project Settings → Create .aiignore — same syntax as .gitignore; Junie respects it; Claude Agent/Codex/Copilot do not

rows.label: Also supported
rows.value: .cursorignore, .codeiumignore, .aiexclude in project root are treated identically to .aiignore

rows.label: Data not stored by default
rows.value: JetBrains AI service does not store code unless Send detailed code-related data is explicitly enabled (opt-in)

rows.label: Enable detailed data sharing
rows.value: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing → Send detailed code-related data (required for Experimental Features)

rows.label: Review sent prompts
rows.value: Search Everywhere → Open AI Assistant Requests Log in Editor → opens ai-assistant-requests.md

rows.label: Network-level block
rows.value: Block https://api.jetbrains.ai/ and https://api.app.prod.grazie.aws.intellij.net/ to disable at the network level

rows.label: BYOK data flow
rows.value: API key mode: prompts go directly to your third-party provider; JetBrains does not see them

rows.label: Disable permanently
rows.value: Widget → Disable AI Assistant → Disable Permanently via Plugin → click Disable on the plugin page
